parent_objective: design a no-training policy-side gate for source histories
blocked_by: M1281 admits policy-side gate design but policy-side projection and recurrent-history semantics are not yet specified
supersedes: direct source-history policy evaluation without canonical frame projection design

public_gates: M1282 must preserve actor input contract
M1282 must not use private holdout
M1282 must define canonical 72-frame projection for M1280 history rows
M1282 must define correct-history versus wrong-history policy-side metrics
M1282 must keep fault condition and pair labels outside actor inputs
forbidden_shortcuts: do not add branch/fault labels to actor-view frames
do not append cmd_* as extra actor observation channels
do not use per-wheel fault metadata as actor input
do not treat policy-side action differences as closed-loop self-identification proof
do not claim high-fidelity validation from the compact pilot

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs the policy-side gate that will consume M1280 source histories through canonical recurrent actor semantics
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: gate design only; no training, promotion, private-holdout, paper-level, recurrent-belief, high-fidelity, or self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if canonical frame projection cannot be defined without leaking labels
stop if correct-history and wrong-history metrics cannot be evaluated without actor-input expansion
stop if the gate would require training or PPO
fallback_plan: if the gate is designable, admit no-training implementation
if command/history semantics are ambiguous, route to projection schema audit
if actor contract mismatch is fundamental, route to source-history materialization repair
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1281 admits source-history policy-side gate design

admission_evidence: M1281 wrong-history rows are same-pair opposite-condition swaps
M1281 identifies canonical projection caveat for cmd_* fields
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review
one next manifest if design admits implementation
next_stage_criteria: history replay through recurrent hidden state is specified
implementation artifacts and pass/fail conditions are specified

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1282 only designs a gate; future implementation must evaluate whether correct-history hidden state changes action likelihood beyond current-frame information.
history_necessity_tests: compare correct history against same-pair wrong history at the same current intervention observation
compare correct history against zero or reset hidden as secondary diagnostics
report null results as task or gate evidence rather than weakening the self-ID claim standard
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1282 specifies a 24-step prefix replay window but does not execute actor evaluation.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If a future gate finds weak history sensitivity, route to gate/input/history repair instead of training.
allowed_claims: no strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, high-fidelity validation, real-vehicle, or paper-result claim

hypothesis: A no-training policy-side gate can be designed to test whether a recurrent actor is sensitive to M1280 correct-history versus wrong-history prefixes under the canonical 72-value human-view contract.
success_criteria: design defines canonical projection from M1280 history rows to 72-value actor frames
design defines normalization for response stream indices
design defines implementation artifacts and pass/fail conditions
design blocks direct training and PPO
no training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, threshold relaxation, or actor-input expansion occurs
failure_criteria: design would append noncanonical history fields to actor observations
design uses fault condition pair labels as actor inputs
design treats action-level sensitivity as closed-loop self-identification proof
training, PPO, private holdout, promotion, threshold relaxation, or actor-input expansion occurs
decision_rule: M1282 passes if it defines a no-training policy-side source-history gate without actor-input expansion or self-identification overclaiming.
